科研.title: Faithfulness Without Anchors: A Position Paper on the Structural Misalignments of Explainable AI Faithfulness Metrics for Feature Importance
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.12493v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) tools have often been presented as methods to increase trust in machine learning models by making aspects of their algorithms more human-understandable. However, evidence accumulated over the last decade points to an overall failure of this objective, instead promoting overreliance on incorrect predictions, which can subsequently lead to algorithmic aversion. Rather, XAI appears to function primarily as a debugging tool, useful for obtaining anecdotal insights into, for example, features learned by the model. One of the main issues underlying this limitation is that XAI methods often oversimplify the inner workings of the model, resulting in misalignment between the explanation and the model itself - a behavior referred to as unfaithfulness or infidelity. Faithfulness can be interpreted as the degree of approximation between an explanation and the model. Computing faithfulness in a rigorous manner would thus make it possible to quantify one of the various elements of trustworthiness of an explanation. However, existing metrics present significant limitations, making this quantification either infeasible or computationally expensive. In this position paper, we outline five major shortcomings of current faithfulness metrics and propose four possible avenues for research to bolster their reliability.

科研.title: EliteTable: Self-Improving Program Search for Executable Control Policies
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.12536v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: EliteTable is a self-improving program-search algorithm guided by large language models (LLMs) that uses a fixed-capacity table of high-scoring solutions to guide new proposals, edits of existing solutions, and remixes of several solutions. Performance was evaluated across six Gymnasium control tasks, each with ten generations and fifty candidate slots per generation. Each task was evaluated across ten independently initialized searches. Candidate-score medians rose between the first and final generations in all six tasks, and selected-winner search-score medians rose in five. In CartPole-v1, the selected winner reached the search-score ceiling in the first generation of all ten searches. All ten paired held-out endpoints improved in four of the six tasks. BipedalWalker-v3 and CarRacing-v3 improved without reaching their reporting targets. Six of ten Acrobot-v1 searches declined on held-out episodes, and the median paired change was negative. The results document improvement during program search and the transfer of selected-winner gains to new episodes in some tasks. Comparisons and ablations are needed to establish EliteTable's relative performance and the contributions of its components.

科研.title: Equal-Budget Monte Carlo Tree Search versus Randomized-Restart List Scheduling for DAG Workflows: A Controlled Equal-Budget Computational Study
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.12542v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is often proposed for scheduling directed-acyclic-graph (DAG) workflows, yet most studies never run the comparison that could refute it - giving a much simpler method the same search effort. We run that comparison under a controlled protocol. All arms receive an identical budget - the same number of candidate schedules built and evaluated: an MCTS scheduling method, preregistered as the main arm; a randomized-restart list scheduler with no search tree as the control; and a textbook-UCT MCTS arm as a registered follow-up on the same domain. The analysis plan was locked before data collection; an independent checker confirmed all 768 confirmation-stage schedules valid with correct finish times. At the main budget of 2048 evaluated schedules, MCTS is 2.88% worse than the restarts (95% CI [-3.62%,-2.15%]; the 72 of 96 held-out instances with positive baseline-relative headroom). The deficit is not budget starvation: on the separate exploration pool restarts self-improve by 1.85% where MCTS gains 0.24%, and 700 of 720 of MCTS's first results are merely the warm start it was handed. The studied selection rule locks deterministically onto the first-expanded child, keeping its trials correlated while restarts draw gains from the tails; the causal link to makespan remains an inference. A structural map locates where the tree stops paying: restarts win on sparse irregular workflows, no difference is detectable on regular layered ones, and dense ones leave no room to improve. Swapping the rule for textbook UCT removes most of the deficit (-0.26%, 95% CI [-0.71%,+0.23%]) without reversing its sign. Results are confined to a controlled synthetic domain (N in {8,16,32} tasks, 2-8 processors, budgets up to 2048); we make no claim about larger budgets.

科研.title: Know What You Don't Know: Agentic Data Synthesis by Evolving Generation Space for Closed-Loop Learning
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.12593v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The continued improvement of large language models increasingly depends on synthetic experience, yet effective data synthesis for interactive agents requires not only executable and verifiable trajectories, but also interactions that provide learning value for the current task agent. Existing methods increasingly incorporate environment feedback, data validation, or learner failures, but still face a feedback-to-decision gap: observed weaknesses do not directly specify how future synthesis should change, or whether they can be represented by the current synthesis space. To address this gap, we propose EvoSyn, a learning-feedback-driven multi-agent framework that organizes synthesis around a revisable state specifying what interaction factors can be deliberately generated and where synthesis effort should be allocated. A role-specialized multi-agent system translates learner feedback into synthesis revisions, while a Designer allocates synthesis directions and a Planner grounds them into executable experience. This process enables within-space adaptation toward weak or under-covered regions and synthesis-space expansion that promotes newly discovered factors into explicit generation controls. Experiments on $\tau^2$-Bench and CAR-Bench show that EvoSyn improves average task success by 13.3 points over the strongest synthesis baseline, while producing higher-quality and structurally broader synthetic experience and discovering controllable factors missed without learner feedback.

科研.title: Algebraic Integer Quantization for Machine Learning Applications
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.12494v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this article, we propose algebraic integer number formats (AINF) as a framework for highly configurable and accurate compressed computation. A key property of AINF is its straightforward reduction to purely integer arithmetic, enabling error-free multiply-accumulate operations. We develop a matrix multiplication engine that exploits this property, obtaining performance within a predictable factor of the most efficient numerical counterparts on modern hardware accelerators. Another key advantage of AIQ is the freedom to select algebraic integers tailored to the numerical characteristics of a given use case, offering optimization opportunities that are fundamentally unavailable in floating-point or fixed-point formats. Motivated by these properties, we introduce algebraic integer quantization (AIQ), a lossy compression format for large language model (LLM) inference, and provide results demonstrating that AIQ achieves competitive accuracy compared to the industry-standard MX format across a diverse set of models and benchmarks at equivalent bit-per-parameter budgets. The experiments presented in this article employ algebraic integers of degree two (quadratic integers); generalizations to higher-order and, in particular, multidimensional algebraic integers promise even greater computational advantages and remain a promising direction for future work.

科研.title: An Input-Dependent Readout Phase for Resonant Sequence Models
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.12496v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sequence models with a fixed-size state avoid the quadratic cost of attention, but face a design choice. An input-dependent state transition gives content-dependent memory at the cost of FFT-based training, while a fixed transition keeps the O(T log T) convolutional path but reads memory the same way for every input. ResonatorLM, a recent model of the second kind, reads a bank of damped complex oscillators through a fixed learned phase per head. We make that readout phase a function of the current token, which adds input dependence to the read only, keeps the convolution exact, and costs 0.2 percent more parameters. An analysis of the untrained bank shows that phase does encode elapsed time, but an ordinary token falls below the background within 2-8 steps and no choice of damping extends linear reconstruction beyond about 16 tokens. In 6M-parameter character-level models on WikiText-2, the input-dependent phase matches the original at the training length and removes its failure beyond it: trained on 256 tokens and tested on 1024, perplexity falls from 12.81 to 3.76. We trace the failure to long-memory heads that accumulate more history than training exposed them to. The learned phase tracks the current character rather than distance and does not improve retrieval.

科研.title: Behind-the-Meter Photovoltaic Visibility from Net Smart Meters: Deployment Regimes and Operational Insights
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.12527v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distribution operators need visibility of behind-the-meter photovoltaic (PV) generation, yet most residential customers are observed only through net smart meters. Deep-learning-based PV disaggregation can restore this visibility, but its operational value depends on whether the model serves known customers, new customers, future periods, or new regions. We quantify this dependence using four deployment regimes that separate household transfer from temporal extrapolation, applied to Ausgrid smart-meter data with cross-dataset adaptation to the Pecan Street data. Using a fixed training protocol, we benchmark representative deep sequence architectures for PV disaggregation under regime-matched evaluation. At a fixed 48-hour context length, daylight mean absolute error (MAE) of the best model rises from 0.104~kW on seen households in the future test period to 0.185~kW on unseen households over the same period, and under a fixed training contract the deployment regime explains far more of the error variation than model choice. Under target-domain normalization, fine-tuning on five target-region households reduces source-model transfer error by 28\%--36\%. Long input windows help known-customer extrapolation, while their new-customer benefits vary by model. These findings suggest regime-matched error budgets, limited target supervision for model adaptation in new regions, and use-case-dependent context selection for energy data analytics.

科研.title: GlucoPRISM: Protocol-Supervised Pretraining for Cross-Cohort Glucose Transfer
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.12528v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) foundation models encode each day as one vector that mixes who the person is, what happened that day and how the sensor measured it, so measurement differences travel with the representation into new cohorts. We ask whether pretraining can place the measurement component that harms transfer in known coordinates, so that deployment drops them with a fixed projection and no target data. GlucoPRISM supervises a GlucoFM backbone with response contracts, rules for how each part of the representation should change when only the day or only the sensor changes: a 64-dimensional Trait band should change with neither, a 48-dimensional State band only across days, and a 16-dimensional Sensor band should track the device. Synthetic sensor views calibrated on paired Dexcom and Libre recordings, different-day pairs and glucose-summary targets supply this supervision without clinical labels. Across twelve cross-cohort directions, dropping the Sensor band from the same frozen encoder raises mean transfer AUROC from 68.75 to 73.57, against 69.3 for GlucoFM. The gain has two parts. Into CGMacros, the one target cohort recorded with two sensor types, filtering adds 11 to 19 points, and this holds when the generator is recalibrated on half of the participants and scored on the other half. On the other eight directions filtering is neutral and the encoder itself exceeds GlucoFM by 3.5 points. The device remains linearly decodable after filtering, so the filter removes a device-related component that harms transfer rather than all measurement information. The retained bands improve window AUROC on thirteen of fourteen public task--cohort cells (Holm-adjusted p=0.031) and correlation on fourteen of fifteen clinical endpoints in an external cohort of 9,303 participants.

科研.title: The quantum geometry of the chemical bond
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.12746v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic properties of materials depend both on band energies and quantum geometry of electronic states. We relate bonding indices to the quantum geometric tensor (QGT), showing how chemical bonding dictates the momentum-space texture of bands, bridging chemical and physical descriptions of solids. We show the QGT decomposed into the three center bond index, weighted by their oriented area. Resolving these contributions by orbital pair reveals the donor--acceptor character that distinguish ionic, covalent, hypervalent, and metavalent bonding. We identify the bonding pattern for topology in materials: noncollinear three center bonds, which are the source of Berry curvature in solids. Bond fluctuation can be directly linked to electromagnetic response by resolving their energy spectrum, opening a quantitative route towards the design of physical properties of materials from bonding motifs.

科研.title: Corrugated Niobene: Stability, Mechanical and Electronic Properties from First-Principles Calculations
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.12749v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The growing diversity of two-dimensional (2D) materials has expanded opportunities in electronics, energy technologies, catalysis, and optical applications. Within this landscape, understanding how corrugated architectures accommodate metallic bonding and influence the stability and properties of monoelemental niobium sheets remains an open research direction. Here, we propose a corrugated niobene nanosheet, denoted c-Nb, and investigate its structural, energetic, vibrational, mechanical, electronic, and optical properties using density functional theory simulations. The optimized structure adopts a centrosymmetric P-3m1 symmetry, with six atoms per primitive cell and a geometrical thickness of 4.279 Angstrom. Its cohesive energy of -6.03 eV/atom indicates strong binding relative to isolated atoms, although bulk BCC Nb remains energetically favored by 2.49 eV/atom. The absence of imaginary phonon frequencies along the investigated high-symmetry path and the positive-definite in-plane stiffness matrix support dynamical and mechanical structural stability. Despite its pronounced corrugation, the nanosheet exhibits isotropic in-plane elasticity, with Young's and shear moduli of 43.66 N/m and 13.66 N/m, respectively, and a Poisson's ratio of 0.598. Electronic states near the Fermi level are dominated by Nb 4d orbitals, establishing multiband metallicity. These findings identify a corrugated structural candidate that combines strong cohesion, elastic compliance, and metallic electronic behavior, extending the structural diversity of monoelemental 2D metals and providing a basis for further exploration of niobium nanosheets in electronic and ultraviolet-responsive systems.

科研.title: Dynamic Chemical Changes of Ti3C2Tx MXenes in Halide Perovskite Precursor Environments
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.12771v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The integration of two-dimensional Ti3C2Tx MXenes into Halide Perovskite (HaP) optoelectronics has shown immense potential for enhancing device performance, yet the fundamental chemical interactions within the precursor ink (a critical stage determining the final material state) remain largely unexplored. This study presents a comprehensive investigation into the chemical stability and surface evolution of Ti3C2Tx MXenes when exposed to the individual and combined components of a model methylammonium lead iodide (MAPbI3) solution. By combining detailed X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS) analysis with Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations, we decouple the complex interactions between MXenes and the ink constituents. We demonstrate that elemental iodine (I2) and polyiodides (In-) act as aggressive oxidizers, triggering rapid degradation and dissolution of the MXene flakes. Conversely, lead iodide (PbI2) induces a slower oxidation process driven by the strong adsorption of Pb2+ ions onto oxygen terminated sites. In stark contrast, methylammonium iodide (MAI) exhibits a stabilizing effect: it adsorbs onto the MXene surface via hydrogen bonding, effectively passivating the flakes and retarding degradation. In addition, our results reveal that the sequence of precursor addition governs the MXene surface state, requiring extra caution, but also enabling further tunability. These findings provide a critical view on how MXene integration with materials, in general, and HaP in particular, should be perceived, providing a fundamental for their rational engineering.

科研.title: Realizing Two-Dimensional Altermagnets with 100% Spin Polarization along the [110] Direction in Ambidentate-Ligand Based Square Organometallic Lattices
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.12791v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism, as a novel magnetic paradigm, not only possesses a zero net magnetic moment, but also exhibits a substantial nonrelativistic spin-splitting effect. Currently, developing a simple and experimentally feasible method for designing altermagnets is eagerly pursued. Moreover, achieving 100% spin polarization along certain directions in valence or conduction bands for altermagnets remains challenging. To address these issues, based on a tight-binding model, we propose a viable chemical strategy for constructing organometallic altermagnets by using ambidentate ligands. Furthermore, in these organometallic altermagnets, direction-dependent 100% spin polarization along the [110] direction in band edges can be induced via the coexistence of altermagnetically spin-split dispersive and flat bands, where the flat band suppresses electron transport in one spin channel and the dispersive band enables conduction in the other spin channel. Then, via first-principles calculations, a screening of 90 two-dimensional ambidentate-ligand based square organometallic lattices leads to the identification of three altermagnetic materials, namely Fe(taz)2Cl2 (taz = 1,2,4- triazine), Co(app)2Cl2, and Fe(app)2Cl2 (app = 1,4-azaphosphinine), all of which possess 100% spin polarization along the [110] direction in valence bands, as well as notable piezomagnetic behavior. This study paves the way for achieving direction-dependent fully spin-polarization in altermagnetic materials.

科研.title: UV Fluorescence Sensing of Medical-Chemical-and- Biological Analytes by an AlGaN/Si-on-Sapphire Optoelectronic Chip
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.13525v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper proposes and analyzes a compact fluorescence-photometer lab-on-a-chip that is simpler than a fluorescence spectrometer, and that does not require spectrum reconstruction by a computer. An on-chip AlGaN VCSEL lasing at 280 nm, or at 310 nm, pumps an on-chip sample in the form of liquid or solid or tissue, thereby exciting signature fluorescence in the 300 to 540 nm wavelength range. This emission signal is detected and read out by an on-chip UV-enhanced Silicon photodiode. The 2 cm x 5 cm chip consists of C-plane (0001) Sapphire, and no lenses, prisms, or mirrors are utilized in the photometer. The chip is opto-electronic and features co-packaged electronics using tiny electronic chiplets that are bonded to the sapphire. These consist of an LD driver and transimpedance amplifier for the UV photonics, together with ASICs, ADC, microcontroller, micro-battery and RF-wireless or Ethernet chiplets. The mission of this self-contained cost-effective chip is sensing targeted medical-chemical-biological (MCB) agents in a local or network setting. Eight significant MCB applications are detailed here.

科研.title: Thin-film nanostructuring of NbTi superconducting resonators for enhanced temperature sensitivity in cryogenic thermometry
科研.summary: arXiv:2605.01915v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The rising complexity of cutting-edge cryogenic systems is currently imposing challenging technical constraints to the monitoring of ultra-cold temperatures through standard commercially available sensors. Among different technologies, superconducting microwave resonators have been recently investigated as ideal candidates for performing on-chip cryogenic thermometry, in reason of their intrinsically low power dissipation, large temperature sensitivities and excellent sub-$\mu$K resolution below 10 K. Through this study, we aim at demonstrating the possibility to enhance the temperature performance of superconducting microwave resonators by means of surface nanostructuring. Different arrays of nanotrenches are strategically patterned on the inductive line of a 1.3 GHz planar resonator, by partially etching a Nb$_{50}$Ti$_{50}$ thin-film, in order to tune the critical transition of the material and, therefore, increase the curvature of the $f_{res}(T)$ response. Although the presence of such thinned superconducting regions introduces larger microwave losses, a 1.5 K decrease of $T_\text{C}$ is recorded, which directly translates into an enhancement of the temperature sensitivity by a factor 10, with respect to a non-nanostructured sensor. A maximum value of $df_{res}/dT = 62 \ \text{MHz/K}$, at 4.2 K, is achieved for the device showing the largest nanotrench width of about 350 nm. These results demonstrate that such a surface nanostructuring approach can be exploited as an effective design strategy to tune the $f_{res}(T)$ response of superconducting microwave resonators. Although this technique is found to introduce additional RF losses into the superconducting device, thereby limiting the achievable temperature resolution to the few-$\mu\text{K/Hz}^{1/2}$ range, we believe that similar approaches could be further investigated for the development of future cryogenic sensors.

科研.title: Towards Accurate MHz Core Loss Measurements
科研.summary: arXiv:2610.07596v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Miniaturized magnetic components play an important role in achieving high efficiency and high power density in power converters. Accurate core loss data are essential when optimizing magnetic components, but making accurate core loss measurements remains challenging, especially at MHz frequencies. As a result, many research groups have developed their own testers in pursuit of improved accuracy, and the amount of published core loss data has increased. However, large variations in these data shed light on fundamental barriers to accurate MHz core loss measurement. This paper identifies these barriers and presents methods for overcoming them.

科技.title: 曝华为将全面回归：畅享 100 系列手机、子品牌、Air 产品线、麒麟 7 / 8 / 9 系芯片“来势汹汹”
科技.summary: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，博主 @数码闲聊站 在今年 7 月曾发文，称华为现在还是回血状态，Mate 90 系列手机 + τ 定律芯片应该是转折点。 时间转眼来到 10 月，华为 Mate 90 系列手机已于本月初正式发布，全球首款逻辑折叠 τ 芯片麒麟 9050 Pro 也随着华为 Mate XT 2 非凡大师三折叠手机在 9 月初登场。 IT之家注意到，博主今日发文，再次谈及了华为的全面回归，透露接下来 子品牌、畅享 100 系列手机、Air（有 WATCH Air）产品线、麒麟 7 / 8 / 9 系芯片 “来势汹汹”。 作为参考，华为手机业务的巅峰时期常被认为是 2019 年-2020 年。2020 年 3 月，华为公布了 2019 年年报，其中提到， 华为 2019 年净利润 627 亿元人民币，智能手机发货量超 2.4 亿台 。而在 2020 年，华为推出了一代经典 —— Mate 40 系列手机。据华为终端 BG CEO 何刚去年在西安电子科技大学上透露， 该系列机型仍有千万用户 。 当年的华为本品牌有畅享、nova、P（Pura 前身）和 Mate 四大系列，子品牌荣耀也有畅玩、Play、X、V、数字和 Magic 系列。产品规划上，华为 Mate、P 和 nova 系列、荣耀 V、数字和 Magic 系列正代机型会搭载麒麟 9 系旗舰芯；荣耀 X 系列和部分华为 nova 产品则会选用麒麟 8 系芯；而畅享、畅玩、Play 系列则会采用更入门的麒麟 7 系芯片。 ▲ IT之家图赏：华为 nova 14 Ultra 实拍 但随着后续美国政府制裁的不断升级，华为选择出售主打性价比的子品牌荣耀，同时自己的四大产品线也发展受限。后续的华为旗舰机，例如 Mate 50、P60 等均不支持 5G，也没有搭载麒麟芯片。直到 2023 年，华为在毫无预告的情况下正式上架 Mate 60 系列手机，情况才有所转变。到今年 3 月，华为终端 BG 首席执行官何刚在春季全场景新品发布会上， 正式官宣华为手机全面回归 。 今年 9 月，有消息称华为手机板块正酝酿新一轮子品牌布局 ，传闻中的线上性价比品牌最快有望在今年 11 月落地。最新动态显示，华为近期申请注册了“星芒”商标，当前处于“等待实质审查”阶段，商品 / 服务范围包括笔记本电脑、手机等。目前，微博已出现“华为被曝将推子品牌星芒”的词条。 如果博主爆料属实，那么意味着后续华为新子品牌有望承接之前旧荣耀品牌的定位，让消费者可以用更低的价格买到最新旗舰处理器并运行鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 系统的手机。同时，麒麟 7 系列处理器的回归、全新 Air 产品线的规划，也会让华为手机 / 平板的产品价格进一步下探。

科技.summary: 陶哲轩提出「数学 2.0」：AI 解题之外，还要帮助人理解证明 10 月 11 日，数学家陶哲轩公开了在加州理工学院的演讲《数学 2.0》。他认为，AI 正在降低部分数学问题的求解成本，使数学研究逐渐从「证明稀缺」走向「证明富足」。但目前多数前沿问题仍未解决，不能只凭公开传播的成功案例判断 AI 的整体能力。 陶哲轩指出，得到正确证明，并不意味着研究者理解了证明为何成立，或掌握了可用于其他问题的新方法。他主张用 AI 寻找更易理解的证明、整理分散的研究成果，并对大量数学问题开展系统分析。例如，等式理论项目通过人类与自动化工具协作，对超过 2200 万个命题作出了判定。 对于 AI 解题能力的评估，他还呼吁公开计算资源消耗、失败尝试等信息。在陶哲轩看来，未来数学研究既要利用 AI 扩展探索范围，也要保留人类对证明及其现实应用的理解和判断。（来源：机器之心） Claude 爆发大规模封号潮：半年封杀 1140 万个账号申诉后仅 4.2 万翻案 10 月 11 日，据媒体报道，近期 Claude 账号封禁问题引发开发者讨论。受到关注的一项数据来自 Anthropic 今年 7 月发布的报告：2026 年上半年，平台累计封禁约 1140 万个账号；收到约 39.8 万次申诉，其中约 4.2 万次申诉成功。报告未披露完整的封禁原因分布，仅凭这些数字也无法判断近期封号是否增加，但申诉结果使平台的封禁标准和复核机制受到关注。 Anthropic 列出的违规情形包括利用服务从事违法活动、侵犯隐私，以及违反地区使用限制等。今年上半年，Anthropic 还向相关儿童安全组织提交了超过 1.5 万起报告。 此外，Anthropic 近期修订了 Claude 使用政策，计划自 11 月 12 日起禁止用户在没有明显目的的情况下，反复对模型实施极端残忍行为。公司称，新规针对的是极端情形；用户表达不满、反驳模型、创作黑暗题材内容，以及开展模型测试与研究，不属于该项禁令的范围。（来源：快科技） 英伟达洽谈收购 Reflection AI，已投资 8 亿美元，后者估值达 250 亿美元 10 月 11 日，据媒体报道，英伟达正与美国人工智能初创企业 Reflection AI 就潜在收购或进一步扩大投资展开初步谈判，交易可能采取全面收购、追加股权投资、提供更多芯片及算力支持，或通过聘用员工并获得技术授权等多种形式。英伟达此前已向 Reflection AI 投资 8 亿美元，是其最大股东之一。 知情人士透露，双方可能在未来数周内达成协议。Reflection AI 今年 3 月融资时的估值达到 250 亿美元，其开发的开放权重 AI 模型被美国政府视为抗衡 DeepSeek 等低成本竞争对手的重要技术资源。（来源：新浪科技） 消息称 OLED 屏新款 iPad mini 售价将大幅上涨，或接近 799 美元 10 月 11 日，彭博社记者马克 · 古尔曼表示，苹果计划本月晚些时候推出新款 iPad mini。新机的起步存储空间可能会有所提升，但有意换机的用户得提前做好涨价的准备。 古尔曼透露，新款 iPad mini 售价相比现款机型将大幅上涨，预计将接近 799 美元（IT 之家注：现汇率约合 5,359 元人民币）。作为对比，现款 iPad mini 7 价格为 599 美元（现汇率约合 4,017 元人民币）/4,799 元人民币。 据悉，新款 iPad mini 将首次采用 OLED 屏幕，配备重新设计的机身。预计将拥有全新扬声器系统，搭载性能更强的芯片。（来源：IT 之家） 京东预约超 200 万人：苹果 iPhone Duo 折叠屏手机 15999 元起倒数 5 天预售 10 月 11 日，iPhone Duo 定价 15999 元起，国行 10 月 16 日晚 8 点接受预购。 京东目前预约人数已超 200 万人，需要注意的是： iPhone Duo 仅支持 eSIM 京东渠道首批可能需要签收激活（以下单时宝贝标题 / 咨询客服为准，就算不用任何补贴，也需激活后才能签收）（来源：IT 之家） 尊界：踏板升级方案预计于 10 月底确认，11 月起陆续启动升级 10 月 11 日下午，尊界客服向记者确认，尊界 V800 制动踏板支架底座升级方案预计于 10 月底确认，11 月起陆续启动升级。 10 月 8 日晚，尊界汽车发布关于尊界汽车制动踏板支架底座相关问题的情况说明，称将进一步优化该部件设计，并为已交付用户提供免费升级选择。 11 日下午，尊界客服告诉记者，目前，已提车的用户可通过全国任一服务中心预约登记，也可直接联系购车门店登记，届时用户中心将会第一时间联系用户；而未发运车辆会被直接升级后再交付，用户无需额外操作。（来源： 北京日报 ） 比亚迪李柯：五年内赶超丰田、大众 登顶全球车企销量第一 10 月 11 日，日前，比亚迪执行副总裁、国际业务负责人李柯在新加坡一场峰会上明确了公司下一阶段的全球战略目标，计划未来五年内赶超丰田和大众，成为全球最大汽车制造商。她表示，比亚迪将坚持出海战略，持续开拓欧洲、中美洲、南美洲、亚洲和大洋洲市场，并强调公司在储能、光伏、电池等多个领域实现领跑，电池技术是核心竞争力之一，优势不只在汽车。 谈到美国市场，李柯明确表示暂时不进入，原因是美国拟以立法形式强化对中国相关联网汽车及车辆软件进入美国市场的限制，即便在美国设厂的极星，也不得不转向其他市场销售。（来源：cnBeta） SpaceXAI 官方账号更名为 SpaceX Super Intelligence 10 月 11 日，马斯克当地时间 10 月 10 日在社交平台发布一张截图，显示 SpaceXAI 的官方账号已更名为「SpaceX Super Intelligence」（@SpaceXSI）。 此前 10 月 4 日，马斯克表示，SpaceX 是一家超级智能（SI）公司，我们将把 SpaceXAI 改名为 SpaceXSI。（来源：财联社） 高通 CEO：有 AI 公司希望 2028 年让手机持续运行千亿参数模型 10 月 11 日，高通 CEO 克里斯蒂亚诺·阿蒙透露，部分前沿 AI 公司希望到 2028 年，让手机能够持续运行参数量达 1000 亿的大语言模型。他没有透露相关公司的名称，也未公布高通的产品计划；2028 年是这些企业提出的目标，并非商用手机的确定上市时间。 内存是目前最直接的障碍。按 4 位量化计算，千亿参数模型仅存放参数就约需 50GB，实际运行还要为系统、应用和推理过程留出空间。手机厂商也需要解决成本、功耗和散热问题。未来能否在手机上实用化，仍取决于模型压缩、芯片设计与内存技术的进展。（来源：cnBeta） 消息称索尼 PS5 Pro 供应紧张局面最早到明年初才能缓解，国内市场已被炒到 7000 元以上 10 月 11 日，据外媒 ComputerBase 报道，索尼一份内部备忘录显示，因《GTA6》造成的 PS5 Pro 供应紧张局面可能还将持续较长时间，最早要到 2027 年初才有望缓解。 今年以来，索尼 PS5 Pro 游戏机价格被不断炒高，以国内市场为例，今年初该机到手价约为 4699 元，而如今已被炒到 7000 元以上，反映出供需失衡对市场价格的影响。 业界公认，《GTA 6》是推动 PS5 Pro 需求增长的最重要因素。不少玩家希望使用性能更强的 PS5 Pro，以更高画质游玩本作。再加上今年以来的内存涨价潮，导致 PS5 Pro 水涨船高、供不应求。这也导致一部分玩家转而购买 PS5 Slim 或 XBOX Series X 游玩《GTA 6》。（来源：IT 之家） 古尔曼：苹果首款智能家庭中枢定名 HomeView，搭载 A18 芯片、四种配色 10 月 11 日，彭博社记者马克 · 古尔曼在新一期《Power On》通讯中透露，苹果首款智能家庭中枢名为「HomeView」，预计将在 10 月 13 日的「欢迎回家」活动正式发布，11 月出货。 据介绍，这款产品的外观设计类似 iMac G4「台灯电脑」，采用悬浮式屏幕，下方配有扬声器底座。该设备将搭载 A18 芯片，官方还将推出壁挂安装版本。 这款新产品将提供深空灰、银色、星光色和粉色四种配色，壁挂版仅有深空灰、银色两种配色。 古尔曼表示，这款产品主要使用语音交互，以 AI Siri 为核心。用户可以在房间另一端查看设备显示内容，并且该产品将运行苹果自家 App，但不支持 App Store。用户或许可以使用 iPhone，将第三方应用的小组件投射到设备上。（来源：IT 之家） 蚂蚁「灵光」开启小范围内测，新版对标「Meta Muse」 10 月 11 日，据悉，蚂蚁集团旗下 AI 产品「灵光」已于近日开启新版本的小范围内测，新版对标「Meta Muse」。公开信息显示，今年 9 月，Meta 推出个人智能体 Muse。该智能体可介入用户日常生活，并持续跟进用户交待的事宜。接近项目人士透露，灵光相关方向约半年前已开始筹备，期间迭代多个版本，计划本月全面开放。 该人士还透露，此次升级的核心，是灵光从能聊天、能生成应用的 AI 助手，转向拥有长期记忆、可主动推进任务的 AI 原生个人智能体。灵光新版本还能通过调用 Skill 和 MCP，实现钉钉发信息、调用智能家居设备等功能。据悉，灵光 2.0 的内测用例集中在长程、变量多、普通人难盯住的场景，例如帮上班族跟踪市场异动、帮家长管理钉钉打卡、旅行中遇航班延误或景区限流重排路线等。（来源：新浪科技） Qwen-Image-2.1 Pro 和 Turbo API 上线千问 AI 平台，将图像生成与编辑能力接入应用 10 月 11 日，千问 AI 平台宣布，Qwen-Image-2.1 Pro 和 Turbo API 现已正式上线千问 AI 平台。开发者可以通过 API 将图像生成与编辑能力接入应用，无需自行部署模型、管理推理环境，即可围绕设计、电商、内容创作等场景搭建自己的工作流。与此同时，Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo 模型权重同步开放。 Qwen-Image-2.1 模型最多支持 10 张参考图输入，支持通过圈选、涂抹和独立掩码明确编辑区域。与此同时，2.1 加强了人像和商品编辑中的一致性表现：在人像编辑中更好地保留面部身份特征，在商品编辑中尽可能保持文字、纹理与形态。此外，Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo 支持 2K 图像生成与图像编辑。 Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo 基于 Qwen-Image-2.1 的 7B 视觉生成架构，将图像生成与编辑的去噪过程缩短至 8 步，同时保留 2K 图像创作能力。（来源：IT 之家） 英国水果蔬菜营养价值下降最高五成 10 月 11 日，据Deep Science Ventures 研究人员的一项研究发现，英国水果和蔬菜的营养价值自 1960 年代以来减少最高五成。英国民众现在需要食用两倍数量的蔬菜，才能摄入与 60 年前同等水平的矿物质如钾、镁或铜。 许多农作物中几种关键营养素的含量减少了 20%-50%。营养和维生素含量的下降主要归因于土壤质量的退化，以及作物在育种时过度追求快速生长，而忽视了其营养价值。正使用减肥药物的人群面临的营养匮乏风险可能最大，因为减肥药会导致他们的食物摄入量显著减少。（来源：solidot）
